_README: Maps exported tracker CSVs for `cycle.py fetch`, one config per front. Drop each front's export at cycles/<date>/tracker_<front>.csv (the legacy single-front cycles/<date>/tracker.csv is still read as front=ekw). ready_values = Status-cell values (case-insensitive) that count as ready-to-fetch. fetch writes one 00_fetched/<id>/ per ready task, tagged _row.json['front'], with _source.txt (the link) and _row.json (the full tracker row, so inline Prompt/Rubric and the Expert Solution Link are preserved). svc/intake column names below are placeholders (fuzzy id/status/link detection as fallback) -- no real header export seen yet for those two trackers; replace *_col once one is available.
